description.narrative:
Insatsen gäller Sidas stöd till en samarbetsplattformen för innovation: International Development Innovation Alliance (IDIA).
IDIA är ett samarbete mellan olika typer av givare inom utvecklingssamarbete med det gemensamma målet att aktivt främja och utveckla innovation för att bidra till att uppnå hållbar utveckling, bland annat genom FN:s Agenda 2030 för hållbar utveckling. IDIA hanteras av ett sekretariat från den ideella organisationen Results for Development (R4D).

The contribution concerns Sida's support for a collaborative innovation platform: the International Development Innovation Alliance (IDIA).
IDIA is a collaboration between different types of development cooperation donors with the common goal of actively promoting and developing innovation to help achieve sustainable development, including through the UN's 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. IDIA is managed by a secretariat of the non-profit organization Results for Development (R4D).

The intervention concerns Sida's support for a collaborative innovation platform: International Development Innovation Alliance (IDIA).
IDIA is a collaboration between different types of development cooperation donors with the common goal of actively promoting and developing innovation to contribute to achieving sustainable development, including through the UN's 2030 Agenda for sustainable development. IDIA is managed by a secretariat of the non-profit organization Results for Development (R4D). Members represent different sectors of development cooperation and representatives are from governments, the private sector, civil society, academia and philanthropists. As the group produces global knowledge goods whose impact is difficult to measure and often beyond the end date of the intervention, the intervention will be monitored on the following process outcomes:
- 8 formal meetings over two years, of which 4 physical and 4 virtual between members
- Documented knowledge on innovation ecosystems at country and context level respectively
- Documented knowledge on how to integrate gender equality, diversity and a localization agenda in innovation programmes
